name: Village of Irvington
gaps: No separate total-coverage/impervious limit for one-family lots (driveways excluded from building coverage)
FAR table (§ 224-136) lists values every 1,000 sf with no interpolation rule; each row's FAR is applied until the next row
Oversized-lot coverage rule (§ 224-13B) read as a cap (lesser of own formula and the larger district's formula), which matches the code's 50,000 sf 1F-10 example
No side_total (two-side) minimum is set; only a single side-yard minimum
2F and MF records use the 1F-5 and 1F-10 rules that the code applies to one-family uses there
Uncodified L.L. 5-2026 amends only MFO special-permit traffic standards (not residential bulk)

wetlands.summary: Art. XXV (§ 224-150+): wetlands/watercourse buffer is 25 ft from the wetland edge, watercourse high-water line or floodplain (DEC's adjacent area for state wetlands); Planning Board permit for controlled activities, and structures within 100 ft of mapped wetlands are reviewed.

steep_slopes.summary: Art. XV resource protection: site capacity for vacant-lot subdivisions/site plans deducts 15% and 25% slopes, wetlands, watercourses, floodplains and watershed land from the base site area (Planning Board determination).

trees.summary: Ch. 202: permit to remove protected trees: 8 in.+ DBH anywhere, 3 in.+ DBH in wetland/watercourse/watershed buffers or on steep slopes, and trees required by approvals.

stormwater.summary: Art. XXVII / Ch. 183: SWPPP for land development disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger common plan).

adu.summary: Art. XXXI: accessory apartment by Planning Board special permit in an owner-occupied one-family house or permitted accessory building, max 2 bedrooms, no exterior changes altering single-family character; village cap of 50 permits.

general.accessory_structures: District yards apply to accessory buildings; none may be nearer the street than the house (§ 224-12). Patios, terraces and walks may enter yards but not within 15 ft of a street line or 4 ft of a property line (§ 224-11B(5)).
general.pools: On lots over 60 ft wide, pool edge at least 20 ft from all property lines and no nearer the street than the house's rear wall; narrower lots follow a width-based table; screening required within 150 ft of a property line (Art. XIII).
general.notes: View Preservation overlay (Art. XXIV), Historic Overlay (Art. XXX) and Croton Aqueduct buffer (§ 224-51C) can add review.

1F-80.name: One-Family Residence 1F-80

max_building_coverage.note: All principal and accessory buildings, excluding driveways (§ 224-13A)

max_floor_area.note: § 224-136 FAR table (rows every 1,000 sf; each row applied up to the next row). Lots 5,000 sf and under 0.43; 80,000+ sf capped at 10,000 sf gross floor area (more needs a ZBA variance). Decks/unenclosed porches excluded; attics 0-100%; basements excluded where front wall exposure < 3 ft; first 250 sf (lots < 10,000) or 400 sf of one-story garage excluded

accessory.notes: No separate accessory setbacks: the district yards apply to all buildings and accessory buildings may not be nearer the street than the house (§ 224-12; Planning Board may allow garages 5-10 ft from the street on steep frontage). Sheds up to 64 sf and 10 ft high may go anywhere except in front of the house, wetlands or the Aqueduct buffer (§ 224-11B(9))

1F-80.source: § 224-10A lot requirements; § 224-11A yards; § 224-13 building coverage; § 224-34 height; § 224-136 FAR
1F-80.notes: Front and side yards may be cut 20% where all facing walls meet the line at 25 degrees or more (§ 224-11B(1)). Lot depth may be 15% less if the average depth meets the minimum.
